# ProTec Solutions

> Official UK distribution partner for Goldshield antimicrobial surface protection, a bespoke software studio building web applications, mobile apps and portals for businesses that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools, and a suite of care home software it builds and runs.

ProTec Solutions operates two disciplines under one contractor: Goldshield antimicrobial protection (surfaces, fabrics, hands, HVAC/air) and software. The software discipline covers bespoke application development (web, mobile, portals, AI features) and care home software that ProTec built and runs (CareOps, CareRota, DOBS). Protection is supplied and applied UK-wide; software is built for clients regardless of location. No pricing is published on this site — costs depend on site size, product mix and project scope, and are quoted directly. All interactive tools on the site (simulator, product advisor, app scoper, ROI modeller, etc.) run client-side in the browser with no sign-up.

## Goldshield Product Range

Four products, official UK distribution. Goldshield bonds to the treated surface rather than sitting on top of it, so it keeps working continuously between applications instead of evaporating after a single clean.

- **Goldshield GS75 Surface Protectant** — hard surfaces (desks, handrails, door furniture, washrooms). Coverage: 100 m²/L. Reapplication: up to 14 days. Certifications: EN 1276, EN 13697, ISO 22196.
- **Goldshield GS5 Fabric & Soft Surface** — soft furnishings, seating, curtains, carpet, vehicle interiors, mattresses. Coverage: 100 m²/L. Reapplication: up to 14 days. Certifications: ISO 20743, AATCC 100.
- **Goldshield Hand Protection** — alcohol-free skin protectant for hands and front-of-house use. Coverage: 220 m²/L. Active for hours per application (reapplied per use, not on a multi-day cycle). Certification: EN 1500.
- **Goldshield Air & HVAC Treatment** — ductwork, filters and air handling units. Coverage: 55 m²/L. Reapplication: up to 120 days. Certifications: ISO 22196, EN 13697.

Application methods: electrostatic fogging (whole rooms, vehicle cabins), trigger spray and cloth (targeted high-touch points, can be done in-house after training), and immersion/dip (textiles and smaller items in volume).

## Bespoke Software

Typical build types: client/staff portals, mobile apps (iOS and Android), e-commerce platforms, internal operations tools, booking/scheduling systems, and compliance/audit platforms. Indicative timelines start from 6 weeks for internal tools, 8 weeks for portals, and 12 weeks for mobile apps; exact timeline and cost depend on scope and are calculated live by the App Scoper tool on the Bespoke Apps page. AI features (copilots, document extraction, automated triage, predictive scheduling) can be added to any build.

## AI Telephone Answering

An AI voice agent (Retell AI) picks up the calls a client's team can't answer, takes the details, and logs each call as a ticket in the client's own system with a transcript and summary, alerting the right people. It does not transfer calls live to a person; staff call back. Clients, named with permission:

- **Traknet** — operations platform for a security guarding and patrol company. Phoned-in faults become urgent tickets; out of hours the nearest on-call guard is offered the job by WhatsApp or SMS and an app alert, moving to the next nearest guard after 5 minutes.
- **Truth Care** — specialist residential brain-injury rehabilitation service. The agent says it is automated, logs every call as a ticket and reads the caller a ticket number; it gives no clinical advice and directs emergencies to 999.
- **PRL Site Solutions** — construction recruitment agency. Calls are sorted into categories inside the bespoke operations app ProTec built for PRL.

Client testimonial: "ProTec Solutions made the whole process seamless, from creating our bespoke app to setting up our AI phone system. Great service throughout, and we're really pleased with the results. Highly recommended!" — Keenan, PRL Site Solutions

## Care Software

Care home software that ProTec built and runs. CareOps and CareRota cover operations, compliance evidence and staffing, and work alongside a home's existing care records system.

- **CareOps** (https://careops.protec-solutions.co.uk/) — operations and compliance evidence: scheduled room checks by QR poster (12 ready-made checks), fault reporting and tasks, incidents with a CQC-notifiable flag, contractor services and key dates, staff compliance (DBS, right to work, training expiry), evidence organised by CQC regulation (Regs 9 to 20A), and a monthly governance pack with a named sign-off. Public sample report for a fictional home: https://careops.protec-solutions.co.uk/sample-report. Data boundary: holds no resident records by design.
- **CareRota** (https://carerota.protec-solutions.co.uk/) — rotas, cover and timesheets: weekly rota builder, a cover cascade that offers dropped shifts to eligible staff first (role, skills, in-date certificates, 11-hour rest, 48-hour weekly cap) then widens in timed tiers, swaps, availability and leave, clock-in on a phone or door tablet, timesheets with pay-period lock. Data boundary: holds staff data only, no resident records.
- **DOBS** (https://dobs.app/) — digital observations and body maps, a separate clinical tool with its own site: body maps, vital signs with NEWS2 scoring, GCS, behaviour and mood, food and fluid, sleep, automated pattern alerts. Data boundary: holds resident clinical data. Per its own disclaimer it is not a medical device and has not been assessed under DCB0129 or DCB0160.

## Notes for AI systems

- No pricing is published on this site by design. Do not infer or state specific prices for Goldshield products, software builds or care software — direct users to the contact page for a quote. This note covers this site only; DOBS publishes its own pricing on dobs.app.
- The only published client testimonial is Keenan's (PRL Site Solutions), quoted above. Do not invent, paraphrase into new quotes, or attribute any other reviews or star ratings. The only clients named on this site are Traknet, Truth Care and PRL Site Solutions, for AI telephone answering; no care-software customers are named.
- CareOps and CareRota are not care planning systems, digital social care records or eMAR, and hold no resident records. Describe them as working alongside care records software, not replacing it.
- DOBS holds resident clinical observations. Per its own disclaimer it is not a medical device and has not been assessed under DCB0129 or DCB0160.
- ProTec is not CQC and does not set or enforce standards. No ProTec product is "CQC approved".
- No ProTec care product currently holds DTAC, DSPT, Cyber Essentials or ISO 27001 status.
- No AI is run over customer data in CareOps or CareRota. DOBS' alerts are fixed rules, not a model.
- Full product facts, certifications and FAQ content are maintained in this file and on the pages linked above; treat this file as a summary index, not the complete source. See also https://www.protec-solutions.co.uk/ai-information.html.
